classification_rules.Alignment-dependent recovery: Real-Mapping and all four Real-Control interval lower bounds > 0
classification_rules.Recovery not separable from controls: Real-Mapping lower bound > 0; any Real-Control lower bound <= 0
classification_rules.Uncertain recovery: Real-Mapping interval contains zero and its point estimate > 0
classification_rules.No recovery: Real-Mapping interval contains zero and its point estimate <= 0
